turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Certainly! The term "privileged" is used to describe advantages or benefits that come automatically to members of a group due to systemic structures. However, recognizing privilege doesn't mean every individual within a group has the same experiences. It's important to acknowledge both the broader systemic advantages and the individual disparities to promote understanding and effective support for all members of diverse groups.
